title: Session-Agent Decoupling
prompt: Decouple sessions from agents so that a Session = unit of work (one DB row in the sessions list) and an Agent = individual Claude instance running within a session. A session holds 1..N agents, eliminating fragile entry-point heuristics, dedup logic, and overflow agent leakage in the UI.

steps.title: IPC contract — Agent type + updated Session + new channels
ipc.ts + preload — new sessionsGetAgents and sessionsAddAgent handlers
Renderer sessions store — remove dedup, add agents + agentEvents
UI views — SessionsList, SessionsView, ContextPanel, LiveSessionView
steps.summary: Removed agencyGroups/agencyInstanceId from all UI views. SessionsList and SessionsView render all persisted sessions uniformly. ContextPanel uses session.agents array. LiveSessionView sources transcript from agentEvents[selectedAgentLocalId]. MonitorView and StatsCards updated for new Session shape. TokenStats and DayUsage interfaces moved to module scope. Legacy import updated for new sessions table schema.
